snippet.title: HELLSLAVE II: JUDGMENT OF THE ARCHON - Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Heaven has run out of patience 🔥Destroy the demon lords… or perish with the world. Discover the gameplay trailer of HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon. 
Coming Q3 on Steam. 👉 Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399900/HellSlave_II_Judgment_of_the_Archon/

What is HELLSLAVE II about?
The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.
